title: TRON configuration: execution.yaml
description: Structural/operational parameters relevant to order submission at the EXECUTE stage (PID §7 step 14). Deliberately bounded to submission-mechanics parameters (supported execution modes, retry/timeout behaviour). Risk/exposure/drawdown limit VALUES are out of scope for this file — see limits.schema.json. Contract-owner of this file: WI-D (WO-TRON-D1).

config_schema_version.description: Configuration schema major version for this file. Must equal "1". See 07-CONFIGURATION.md §2.

supported_execution_modes.description: Execution modes this TRON instance is configured to submit. This is TRON's own configured ceiling, not a broker capability declaration — actual per-broker/per-instrument support is a broker-profile matter (08-BROKER-PROFILES.md) verified against the broker adapter at negotiation/execution time. A mode configured here but unsupported by the broker adapter for a given instrument must not be silently attempted; that reconciliation is negotiation/execution behaviour (CAP-03/CAP-05), not this schema's concern.

order_submission_timeout_ms.description: Maximum time, in milliseconds, TRON waits for a broker acknowledgement of a submitted order before treating the outcome as uncertain. An uncertain broker response is an execution-safety condition that fails closed for new risk (HR-14); how the uncertainty is then resolved is CAP-05 behaviour, not this schema's concern.

order_submission_max_retries.description: Maximum number of resubmission attempts TRON is configured to make for a submission that did not receive a broker acknowledgement within order_submission_timeout_ms. 0 means no automatic resubmission is configured. Any retry behaviour must still preserve HR-13 (a retry must not silently become a second trade); enforcing that is CAP-05 implementation behaviour, not this schema's concern.

retry_backoff_ms.description: Configured delay, in milliseconds, between a submission attempt and a subsequent retry attempt, when order_submission_max_retries permits one.

broker_state_read_timeout_ms.description: Maximum time, in milliseconds, TRON waits when reading a broker/account/instrument state snapshot (e.g. at SNAPSHOT REQUIRED STATE, PID §7 step 11, or protection read-back, step 16) before treating that state as unavailable. An unavailable/stale state read is a broker-state-uncertainty condition that fails closed for new risk (HR-14).
